== Summary ==
Slip “City In The Clouds / You Truly Belong Here With Us” cut unchanged from page 1 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (PDF file created 12 December 2022), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 1239, 1624, 1926)). Version [[City In The Clouds / You Truly Belong Here With Us (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Not a recreation.
